measurements.formula: NDVI = (NIR reflectance - red reflectance) / (NIR reflectance + red reflectance)
measurements.mask_policy: Keep SCL 4 (vegetation) and 5 (not vegetated) on both dates; require valid red/NIR/SCL masks, nonzero raw DNs, nonnegative calibrated reflectance, and a finite positive denominator.
measurements.scope_note: Common valid land in the fixed landscape crop, including nonvegetated surfaces; this is not a parcel or crop-type mask.

change.formula: NDVI change = after NDVI - before NDVI
change.classification_rule: Decreased < -threshold; stable includes both boundaries; increased > threshold. Comparisons use the saved float32 differences and a float32 threshold.
change.scope_note: Demonstration tolerance, not a validated crop-change threshold. Shared valid land includes nonvegetated surfaces. Stable means within the tolerance, not proof of unchanged land or crops. SCL is automated at native 20 m resolution; two dates do not identify crop types or causes.

### Observations

For the first date on 2024-02-20, the saved application measurements show a mean NDVI of 0.4668, a median of 0.4031, a minimum of -0.1436, and a maximum of 0.9453. For the second date on 2025-02-14, the saved application measurements show a mean NDVI of 0.4210, a median of 0.2924, a minimum of -0.0465, and a maximum of 0.9421. The saved change classes are as follows: Decreased NDVI: 895.25 ha (34.15%); Stable NDVI: 1,274.86 ha (48.63%); Increased NDVI: 451.29 ha (17.22%).

### Evidence and interpretations

Normalized Difference Vegetation Index is calculated using near-infrared B08 and red B04 reflectance bands: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04) [MA_SENTINEL_NDVI_METHOD](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/ndvi/). The index ranges from -1 to 1 and serves as a proxy for live green vegetation, where negative values typically relate to water, values near zero to barren surfaces, and positive values to vegetation [MA_SENTINEL_NDVI_METHOD](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/ndvi/). These figures represent general interpretations rather than field-specific diagnoses [MA_SENTINEL_NDVI_METHOD](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/ndvi/). The observed differences reflect shifts in index values across the shared sample between dates, including nonvegetated surfaces. They do not by themselves establish crop loss, yield reduction, crop identity, soil nutrient status, or underlying causes such as weather, irrigation, or management practices.

L'indice NDVI est calculé à partir des bandes de réflectance du rouge et du proche infrarouge selon la formule (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04), sa valeur variant de -1 à 1 en tant qu'indicateur de la végétation verte vivante [MA_SENTINEL_NDVI_METHOD](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/custom-scripts/sentinel-2/ndvi/). Les changements observés ne permettent pas d'identifier formellement les types de cultures, l'identité des parcelles, les rendements, les conditions de sol ni les causes exactes des variations, les surfaces valides incluant des zones non végétalisées.

### Vérifications à réaliser

Il convient de vérifier les limites parcellaires officielles, de consulter des séries temporelles plus denses et d'analyser les registres météorologiques et de gestion agricole locaux.
